phase: Eurostat Counterpart Discovery — Semantic + Lineage Review

construction.F: S12 minus S121, same source concepts
construction.X: counterpart sector S2, with external orientation determined from reporting-sector asset/liability semantics

SECTOR_MAPPING.evidence: Retained JSON-stat metadata exposes reporting-sector codes S11,S12,S121,S13,S14_S15 and counterpart code S2.

COUNTERPART_ORIENTATION.evidence: JSON-stat labels distinguish 'Sector' from 'Counterpart sector'; finpos separately identifies ASS and LIAB, so orientation does not require sign inference.

blockers: F2 is not complete because F21 currency is absent; F22_F29 covers deposits only.
F5 is not complete: retained counterpart codes expose F511 listed shares and F52 investment fund shares but not the full F5 boundary.
INSTRUMENT_MAPPING.rule_applied: Missing required instruments are an unconditional semantic-review FAIL; broader totals, residual allocation, missing-to-zero and post-result boundary reduction are prohibited.

STOCK_FLOW_SEMANTICS.evidence: stk_flow contains separate TRN and STK categories; Eurostat metadata separately defines financial transactions and closing balance-sheet stocks.

ASSET_LIABILITY_SEMANTICS.evidence: finpos contains explicit ASS and LIAB categories.

UNIT_SCALING.evidence: unit includes MIO_NAC = million units of national currency, alongside MIO_EUR and PC_GDP; no value-based unit inference is needed.

CONSOLIDATION_AND_VALUATION.evidence: Eurostat metadata states quarterly financial accounts are non-consolidated and stocks/flows are in principle recorded at exchange or market value.

LINEAGE.evidence: Eurostat metadata states national quarterly financial-account data are transmitted to the ECB, validated there and then transmitted to Eurostat for republication; this dissemination is not independent measurement.

next_action: Proceed to the separately preregistered OECD counterpart discovery probe. Reopen Eurostat only if a future public counterpart dataset/version exposes the complete frozen RMD F2-F8 instrument boundary without prohibited substitutions.
